description.text: The ninth Black & White set and the second Team Plasma set, released on 8 May 2013 with 122 cards: 116 and six secret rares, among them Garchomp, Empoleon, Ultra Ball and Max Potion. Its Pokémon-EX include Deoxys-EX, Thundurus-EX, Latios-EX and Latias-EX, it has all of Eevee's evolutions, and it brought two new ACE SPEC cards, among them Rock Guard.
